title: Temporary Finance Assistant (3 Months)
description:
Temporary Finance Assistant

Dunfermline

Temporary (3 months)

Up to £35k DOE

Office Angels are delighted to be partnering with a well-established global organisation in Dunfermline to recruit a Temporary Finance Assistant for an immediate start. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional looking to join a supportive and fast-paced finance team, with the flexibility of hybrid working once training has been completed.

The Role

Working within the International Finance team, you'll play a key role in supporting Accounts Payable, banking and reconciliation activities across multiple entities and currencies. This is a varied position where accuracy, organisation and strong communication skills are essential.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing a busy shared finance mailbox and responding to supplier queries
- Processing high volumes of invoices using three-way matching procedures
- Preparing and processing weekly supplier payment runs
- Reconciling multiple bank accounts and ensuring transactions are accurately recorded
- Processing employee expenses and related finance postings
- Investigating and resolving invoice discrepancies with internal departments
- Maintaining and reconciling supplier accounts and records
- Applying credit notes and supporting month-end activities
- Assisting with intercompany reconciliations
- Supporting wider finance functions including Accounts Receivable when required
- Producing accurate reports and working with large data sets in Excel

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within a Finance Assistant, Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger or similar finance role
- Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills
- Experience working in a fast-paced environment
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Confident Excel, Outlook and Microsoft Office user
- Experience working with multiple currencies or international entities would be highly advantageous
- ERP system experience is desirable

What's in it for You?

Immediate start available
Hybrid working after initial training period
Free on-site parking
Friendly and supportive team environment
Potential for the assignment to be extended beyond the initial 3 months
Excellent opportunity to gain experience within a global organisation

If you're available immediately and looking for your next temporary finance opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Send your CV to or call to apply!
